Overview

The SC(Z)11~18 large dry-type power transformer has a maximum design production capacity of 25000 kVA. In 2023 the first SCZ12-25000/35 was powered on and has operated safely at the Yungu Project in Hangzhou.

The web through-core structure gives a simple, clean appearance and is easy to maintain. The technology is mature with many application records in commercial centres, real estate, hospitals and other engineering projects.

Design and performance

Functional features

Fire safety
Safe, flame-retardant, fireproof and pollution-free; can be installed directly at the load centre.
Low running cost
Maintenance-free, simple installation, low comprehensive operating cost.
Overload capability
Moisture-proof, low loss, low partial discharge, low noise; 150% rated load under forced air cooling.
Temperature protection
Comprehensive temperature protection and control system.

Product advantages

Step-lap core
High-permeability grain-oriented silicon steel, 45° full-mitre joints, seven-step step-lap; TENAX high-strength strapping reduces loss and noise.
Foil-wound LV coil
Wound on a SCAL foil winding machine imported from France; H-class interlayer insulation, end faces sealed with epoxy resin.
Enclosure options
Aluminium alloy, steel plate or stainless steel shell.
Mechanical strength
Silicone-rubber pads between yokes and coils, bolted compression; all leads machined and burr-free.

Application scope

  • PowerThermal, hydro, nuclear, gas-fired and wind power generation.
  • PetrochemicalOil exploitation, petroleum refining and natural-gas exploitation.
  • TransportationSubway, light rail, airport, ship, highway and urban transport.
  • BuildingsHigh-rise buildings, commercial plazas, communication buildings and residential areas.
  • Industry and miningSpecial equipment supply, factory relocation, mining areas and metallurgy.
